_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Thomas Carlyle (1795-1881) as translator. Goethe's Wilhelm Meister's Apprenticeship (1824) and Travels (1827), and the German tales (Musaeus, Tieck, Richter) of German Romance (1827), as Gutenberg reprints them from 'Translations from the German'. PD. His own works are not shelved here. Added 2026-10-02 by lane C under the coordinator's standing instruction (choose further translator shelves); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

carlyle-meister-1: Wilhelm Meister's apprenticeship and travels, vol. 1
carlyle-meister-2: Wilhelm Meister's apprenticeship and travels, vol. 2
carlyle-german-tales: Translations from the German (Vol 3 of 3): Tales by Musæus, Tieck, Richter

carlyle-german-romance-vol-1.work: German Romance, vol. 1 of 2: Musäus, De La Motte Fouqué (Aslauga's Knight), Tieck
carlyle-german-romance-vol-1.scan_edition: Chapman and Hall, London 1898 (Centenary Edition of the Works, vol. XXI, introduction by H. D. Traill); archive.org scan (Google)
carlyle-german-romance-vol-1.note: The Musäus and Tieck tales are also in Gutenberg 38779 on this shelf; Fouqué's Aslauga's Knight, which the later Translations from the German dropped, is new here.

carlyle-german-romance-vol-2.of: E. T. A. Hoffmann and Jean Paul Richter
carlyle-german-romance-vol-2.work: German Romance, vol. 2 of 2: Hoffmann (The Golden Pot), Richter (Schmelzle's Journey, Quintus Fixlein)
carlyle-german-romance-vol-2.scan_edition: Chapman and Hall, London 1898 (Centenary Edition of the Works, vol. XXII); archive.org scan (UCLA copy)
carlyle-german-romance-vol-2.note: The Richter pieces are also in Gutenberg 38779 on this shelf; Hoffmann's The Golden Pot is new here.

_excluded.carlyle-own-works: Sartor Resartus, The French Revolution etc.: Carlyle's own works, not translations.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
